notes: ADULT. Source .cache/art/sea_adult/tripo_b_01.glb (Tripo P1, face-limit 8000). Tail-tip lateral swing: Swim +-0.073, Dash +-0.091, Idle +-0.042, Glide +-0.02 (model units). Wingless sea dragon. Blender rest coords: head +X, up +Z, dragon's left +Y (glTF head +X, same as fire_adult); the raw Tripo mesh had its head at -Y, so rig_sea.py rotates it +90 deg about Z on import. 36 bones, same names in baby/teen/adult (GLTFLoader strips the dot: farm1.L -> farm1L). Clips (keys from frame 0, first frame == last frame, all loop): Swim 1.5 s, Dash 0.625 s (bigger, faster wave), Glide 2.0 s (almost straight), Idle 3.0 s (legs hanging, slow look-around +-8 deg), Breach 1.0 s (back arched with ~72% of the bend in the front half so the hump reads from the side; legs tucked; fan bone scaled 1.15 on its vertical axis = the only scale track). Undulation is LATERAL (yaw); the tail fin is vertical. Root bone 'hips' carries small yaw + sideways translation keys that keep chest/neck/head steady: do not reset hips in a runtime overlay (undo-then-apply is fine). Swim/Dash/Glide/Breach share one streamlined tuck (v3): front legs fold back under the chest with the paws curled up against the belly, hind legs trail straight back under the tail base; every paw stays inside the body width (no frog splay), so they crossfade cleanly; Idle crossfade 0.3-0.5 s. mouthK = (mouth.x - pivot.x) / length = how far the snout tip is ahead of the pivot in body lengths (dragon.js derives the same number). Texture: one 1024 WebP base colour, graded by blender/sea_tex.py (run by rig_sea.py) to the SAME concept targets for all three ages: navy (54,70,88), teal fins + teal patches (73,121,135) with V<=0.56, cream belly (176,187,172), glowing spots (72,224,218) V>=0.8 S>=0.6 filled solid; crest, fan, head crest (teal, copper tips kept) and ear fins (cream, copper edge kept) are found by 3D position (head fins = past the skull outline in rigs json weights.head_fin), copper tips pulled to one shared copper (160,110,80) on all three ages, pale inner legs darkened to navy (also the shoulder faces that turn up in the Breach arch). A glow key of hue 165-200, sat>0.5, V>0.68 lights only the spots. Material doubleSided. Mesh: welded, faces oriented to Tripo's own normals + neighbour vote (again after decimation, never recalc_face_normals), small holes filled, smooth normals; the few faces whose winding still disagrees with their corner normals (where fin sheets crowd together) are flat-shaded, so every face's winding matches its exported normals and the outline shell can never flip in front of a fin (that was the black triangles/shards). Normals are per-corner at those faces (a few hundred split vertices). File: KHR_mesh_quantization + constant rest channels dropped (blender/glb_pack.py); three.js GLTFLoader reads it natively, no decoder. mouth = snout tip in rest pose. Re-rig: blender -b --factory-startup -P blender/rig_sea.py -- blender/rigs/<name>.json
